def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_localtime(match: re.Match[str]) -> time:
    hour_str, minute_str, sec_str, micros_str = match.groups()
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    return time(int(hour_str), int(minute_str), sec, micros)

  152 | def load(__fp: IO[bytes], *, parse_float: ParseFloat = float) -> dict[str, Any]:
  153 |     """Parse TOML from a binary file object."""
  154 |     b = __fp.read()
  155 |     try:
  156 |         s = b.decode()
  157 |     except AttributeError:
  158 |         raise TypeError(
  159 |             "File must be opened in binary mode, e.g. use `open('foo.toml', 'rb')`"
  160 |         ) from None

  164 | def loads(__s: str, *, parse_float: ParseFloat = float) -> dict[str, Any]:
  165 |     """Parse TOML from a string."""
  166 | 
  167 |     # The spec allows converting "\r\n" to "\n", even in string
  168 |     # literals. Let's do so to simplify parsing.
  169 |     try:
  170 |         src = __s.replace("\r\n", "\n")
  171 |     except (AttributeError, TypeError):
  172 |         raise TypeError(
  173 |             f"Expected str object, not '{type(__s).__qualname__}'"
  174 |         ) from None
  175 |     pos = 0
  176 |     out = Output()
  177 |     header: Key = ()
  178 |     parse_float = make_safe_parse_float(parse_float)
  179 | 
  180 |     # Parse one statement at a time
  181 |     # (typically means one line in TOML source)
  182 |     while True:
  183 |         # 1. Skip line leading whitespace
  184 |         pos = skip_chars(src, pos, TOML_WS)
  185 | 
  186 |         # 2. Parse rules. Expect one of the following:
  187 |         #    - end of file
  188 |         #    - end of line
  189 |         #    - comment
  190 |         #    - key/value pair
  191 |         #    - append dict to list (and move to its namespace)
  192 |         #    - create dict (and move to its namespace)
  193 |         # Skip trailing whitespace when applicable.
  194 |         try:
  195 |             char = src[pos]
  196 |         except IndexError:
  197 |             break
  198 |         if char == "\n":
  199 |             pos += 1
  200 |             continue
  201 |         if char in KEY_INITIAL_CHARS:
  202 |             pos = key_value_rule(src, pos, out, header, parse_float)
  203 |             pos = skip_chars(src, pos, TOML_WS)
  204 |         elif char == "[":
  205 |             try:
  206 |                 second_char: str | None = src[pos + 1]
  207 |             except IndexError:
  208 |                 second_char = None
  209 |             out.flags.finalize_pending()
  210 |             if second_char == "[":
  211 |                 pos, header = create_list_rule(src, pos, out)
  212 |             else:
  213 |                 pos, header = create_dict_rule(src, pos, out)
  214 |             pos = skip_chars(src, pos, TOML_WS)
  215 |         elif char != "#":
  216 |             raise TOMLDecodeError("Invalid statement", src, pos)
  217 | 
  218 |         # 3. Skip comment
  219 |         pos = skip_comment(src, pos)
  220 | 
  221 |         # 4. Expect end of line or end of file
  222 |         try:
  223 |             char = src[pos]
  224 |         except IndexError:
  225 |             break
  226 |         if char != "\n":
  227 |             raise TOMLDecodeError(
  228 |                 "Expected newline or end of document after a statement", src, pos
  229 |             )
  230 |         pos += 1
  231 | 
  232 |     return out.data.dict

  235 | class Flags:
  236 |     """Flags that map to parsed keys/namespaces."""
  237 | 
  238 |     # Marks an immutable namespace (inline array or inline table).
  239 |     FROZEN: Final = 0
  240 |     # Marks a nest that has been explicitly created and can no longer
  241 |     # be opened using the "[table]" syntax.
  242 |     EXPLICIT_NEST: Final = 1
  243 | 
  244 |     def __init__(self) -> None:
  245 |         self._flags: dict[str, dict[Any, Any]] = {}
  246 |         self._pending_flags: set[tuple[Key, int]] = set()
  247 | 
  248 |     def add_pending(self, key: Key, flag: int) -> None:
  249 |         self._pending_flags.add((key, flag))
  250 | 
  251 |     def finalize_pending(self) -> None:
  252 |         for key, flag in self._pending_flags:
  253 |             self.set(key, flag, recursive=False)
  254 |         self._pending_flags.clear()
  255 | 
  256 |     def unset_all(self, key: Key) -> None:
  257 |         cont = self._flags
  258 |         for k in key[:-1]:
  259 |             if k not in cont:
  260 |                 return
  261 |             cont = cont[k]["nested"]
  262 |         cont.pop(key[-1], None)
  263 | 
  264 |     def set(self, key: Key, flag: int, *, recursive: bool) -> None:  # noqa: A003
  265 |         cont = self._flags
  266 |         key_parent, key_stem = key[:-1], key[-1]
  267 |         for k in key_parent:
  268 |             if k not in cont:
  269 |                 cont[k] = {"flags": set(), "recursive_flags": set(), "nested": {}}
  270 |             cont = cont[k]["nested"]
  271 |         if key_stem not in cont:
  272 |             cont[key_stem] = {"flags": set(), "recursive_flags": set(), "nested": {}}
  273 |         cont[key_stem]["recursive_flags" if recursive else "flags"].add(flag)
  274 | 
  275 |     def is_(self, key: Key, flag: int) -> bool:
  276 |         if not key:
  277 |             return False  # document root has no flags
  278 |         cont = self._flags
  279 |         for k in key[:-1]:
  280 |             if k not in cont:
  281 |                 return False
  282 |             inner_cont = cont[k]
  283 |             if flag in inner_cont["recursive_flags"]:
  284 |                 return True
  285 |             cont = inner_cont["nested"]
  286 |         key_stem = key[-1]
  287 |         if key_stem in cont:
  288 |             inner_cont = cont[key_stem]
  289 |             return flag in inner_cont["flags"] or flag in inner_cont["recursive_flags"]
  290 |         return False
  291 |

  293 | class NestedDict:
  294 |     def __init__(self) -> None:
  295 |         # The parsed content of the TOML document
  296 |         self.dict: dict[str, Any] = {}
  297 | 
  298 |     def get_or_create_nest(
  299 |         self,
  300 |         key: Key,
  301 |         *,
  302 |         access_lists: bool = True,
  303 |     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  304 |         cont: Any = self.dict
  305 |         for k in key:
  306 |             if k not in cont:
  307 |                 cont[k] = {}
  308 |             cont = cont[k]
  309 |             if access_lists and isinstance(cont, list):
  310 |                 cont = cont[-1]
  311 |             if not isinstance(cont, dict):
  312 |                 raise KeyError("There is no nest behind this key")
  313 |         return cont  # type: ignore[no-any-return]
  314 | 
  315 |     def append_nest_to_list(self, key: Key) -> None:
  316 |         cont = self.get_or_create_nest(key[:-1])
  317 |         last_key = key[-1]
  318 |         if last_key in cont:
  319 |             list_ = cont[last_key]
  320 |             if not isinstance(list_, list):
  321 |                 raise KeyError("An object other than list found behind this key")
  322 |             list_.append({})
  323 |         else:
  324 |             cont[last_key] = [{}]

  385 | def create_dict_rule(src: str, pos: Pos, out: Output) -> tuple[Pos, Key]:
  386 |     pos += 1  # Skip "["
  387 |     pos = skip_chars(src, pos, TOML_WS)
  388 |     pos, key = parse_key(src, pos)

  390 |     if out.flags.is_(key, Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) or out.flags.is_(key, Flags.FROZEN):
  391 |         raise TOMLDecodeError(f"Cannot declare {key} twice", src, pos)

  393 |     try:
  394 |         out.data.get_or_create_nest(key)
  395 |     except KeyError:
  396 |         raise TOMLDecodeError("Cannot overwrite a value", src, pos) from None

  398 |     if not src.startswith("]", pos):

  400 |             "Expected ']' at the end of a table declaration", src, pos

  405 | def create_list_rule(src: str, pos: Pos, out: Output) -> tuple[Pos, Key]:
  406 |     pos += 2  # Skip "[["

  411 |         raise TOMLDecodeError(f"Cannot mutate immutable namespace {key}", src, pos)

  413 |     out.flags.unset_all(key)

  417 |         out.data.append_nest_to_list(key)
  418 |     except KeyError:
  419 |         raise TOMLDecodeError("Cannot overwrite a value", src, pos) from None

  422 |         raise TOMLDecodeError(
  423 |             "Expected ']]' at the end of an array declaration", src, pos

  428 | def key_value_rule(
  429 |     src: str, pos: Pos, out: Output, header: Key, parse_float: ParseFloat
  430 | ) -> Pos:
  431 |     pos, key, value = parse_key_value_pair(src, pos, parse_float, nest_lvl=0)
  432 |     key_parent, key_stem = key[:-1], key[-1]
  433 |     abs_key_parent = header + key_parent

  435 |     relative_path_cont_keys = (header + key[:i] for i in range(1, len(key)))
  436 |     for cont_key in relative_path_cont_keys:
  437 |         # Check that dotted key syntax does not redefine an existing table
  438 |         if out.flags.is_(cont_key, Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST):
  439 |             raise TOMLDecodeError(f"Cannot redefine namespace {cont_key}", src, pos)
  440 |         # Containers in the relative path can't be opened with the table syntax or
  441 |         # dotted key/value syntax in following table sections.
  442 |         out.flags.add_pending(cont_key, Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
  443 | 
  444 |     if out.flags.is_(abs_key_parent, Flags.FROZEN):
  445 |         raise TOMLDecodeError(
  446 |             f"Cannot mutate immutable namespace {abs_key_parent}", src, pos
  447 |         )

  449 |     try:
  450 |         nest = out.data.get_or_create_nest(abs_key_parent)

  454 |         raise TOMLDecodeError("Cannot overwrite a value", src, pos)

  456 |     if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):

def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_localtime(match: re.Match[str]) -> time:
    hour_str, minute_str, sec_str, micros_str = match.groups()

def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_localtime(match: re.Match[str]) -> time:
    hour_str, minute_str, sec_str, micros_str = match.groups()
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0

def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_localtime(match: re.Match[str]) -> time:
    hour_str, minute_str, sec_str, micros_str = match.groups()
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0

  235 | class Flags:
  236 |     """Flags that map to parsed keys/namespaces."""
  237 | 
  238 |     # Marks an immutable namespace (inline array or inline table).
  239 |     FROZEN: Final = 0
  240 |     # Marks a nest that has been explicitly created and can no longer
  241 |     # be opened using the "[table]" syntax.
  242 |     EXPLICIT_NEST: Final = 1
  243 | 
  244 |     def __init__(self) -> None:
  245 |         self._flags: dict[str, dict[Any, Any]] = {}
  246 |         self._pending_flags: set[tuple[Key, int]] = set()
  247 | 
  248 |     def add_pending(self, key: Key, flag: int) -> None:
  249 |         self._pending_flags.add((key, flag))
  250 | 
  251 |     def finalize_pending(self) -> None:
  252 |         for key, flag in self._pending_flags:
  253 |             self.set(key, flag, recursive=False)
  254 |         self._pending_flags.clear()
  255 | 
  256 |     def unset_all(self, key: Key) -> None:
  257 |         cont = self._flags
  258 |         for k in key[:-1]:
  259 |             if k not in cont:
  260 |                 return
  261 |             cont = cont[k]["nested"]
  262 |         cont.pop(key[-1], None)
  263 | 
  264 |     def set(self, key: Key, flag: int, *, recursive: bool) -> None:  # noqa: A003
  265 |         cont = self._flags
  266 |         key_parent, key_stem = key[:-1], key[-1]
  267 |         for k in key_parent:
  268 |             if k not in cont:
  269 |                 cont[k] = {"flags": set(), "recursive_flags": set(), "nested": {}}
  270 |             cont = cont[k]["nested"]
  271 |         if key_stem not in cont:
  272 |             cont[key_stem] = {"flags": set(), "recursive_flags": set(), "nested": {}}
  273 |         cont[key_stem]["recursive_flags" if recursive else "flags"].add(flag)
  274 | 
  275 |     def is_(self, key: Key, flag: int) -> bool:
  276 |         if not key:
  277 |             return False  # document root has no flags
  278 |         cont = self._flags
  279 |         for k in key[:-1]:
  280 |             if k not in cont:
  281 |                 return False
  282 |             inner_cont = cont[k]
  283 |             if flag in inner_cont["recursive_flags"]:
  284 |                 return True
  285 |             cont = inner_cont["nested"]
  286 |         key_stem = key[-1]
  287 |         if key_stem in cont:
  288 |             inner_cont = cont[key_stem]
  289 |             return flag in inner_cont["flags"] or flag in inner_cont["recursive_flags"]
  290 |         return False

def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_localtime(match: re.Match[str]) -> time:
    hour_str, minute_str, sec_str, micros_str = match.groups()
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
